name: ZeroB Ignite (UF+UV)
summary: ZeroB Ignite UF+UV is a portable water purifier with instant hot water dispensing and advanced 5-stage UF + UV purification. Its refillable 5-litre tank works without a continuous water supply, while multiple temperature and dispensing options make it ideal for tea, coffee, milk, and hot water.
intro: The ZeroB Ignite UF+UV is a premium portable water purifier with instant hot water dispensing, designed for homes and offices. Featuring a refillable 5-litre raw water tank, it works without a continuous water supply while delivering safe, crystal-clear drinking water through advanced 5-stage UF + UV purification. Choose from multiple water temperatures and dispensing volumes to prepare tea, coffee, milk, or hot water instantly. Its sleek, elegant design, compact footprint, and UV-protected pure water tank make it a perfect blend of convenience, hygiene, and style.
